title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management — AI Quality & Evaluation
text:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.
* Evidence of coaching and mentoring colleagues without relying on reporting authority, and the ability to deliver independently in a fast-moving environment.
Clear communication with customers, technical teams, and senior leaders, including an honest account of what is known, uncertain, or still unproven. 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Evaluation platforms, agent systems, AI observability, retrieval, or enterprise AI products.
* Building in an AI-native startup or entrepreneurial environment, taking a new product from early customer learning to adoption, and applying lessons from both successful and unsuccessful experiments.
* Hands-on prototyping with coding agents and delivery of customer-facing performance or outcome experiences.
Leading initiatives that require agreement across research, engineering, product, and customer-facing organizations. 

What success looks like
 
 
Customers see credible improvement in real agent workflows, supported by evaluations they can trust. You independently take an initial quality problem from failure analysis through experimentation and customer validation, and deliver a focused feature with engineering. Teams make better release and investment decisions because of the evidence, product judgment, and coaching you bring.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

The typical base salary range for this position is $218,400 - $365,200 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $263,200 - $401,400 annually.

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.
